mapper.select: /* OrderSQL.selectOrderPrdInfo */ SELECT A.PRD_CD AS "prdCd", #{ordQty} AS "ordQty", A.PRD_NM AS "prdNm", A.SMPL_DESC AS "smplDesc", A.PRD_STAT_CD AS "prdStatCd", B.SALE_PRC AS "salePrc", B.CARD_DISC_PRC AS "cardDiscPrc", B.CASH_DISC_PRC AS "cashDiscPrc", C.IMG_PATH AS "imgPath" FROM TB_PRD_MST A LEFT JOIN TB_PRD_PRC B ON A.PRD_CD = B.PRD_CD LEFT JOIN TB_PRD_IMG C ON A.PRD_CD = C.PRD_CD AND C.IMG_TP_CD = '10' AND C.SORT_SEQ = 1 WHERE A.PRD_CD = #{prdCd} AND A.PRD_STAT_CD IN ('30', '50')
/* OrderSQL.selectMbrInfo */ SELECT MBR_NO AS "mbrNo", MBR_NM AS "mbrNm", HP_NO AS "hpNo", ZIPCODE AS "zipcode", BASE_ADDR AS "baseAddr", DTL_ADDR AS "dtlAddr" FROM TB_MBR WHERE MBR_NO = #{mbrNo}
/* OrderSQL.selectMaxOrdNo */ SELECT MAX(ORD_NO) FROM TB_ORD_MST WHERE ORD_NO LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')

/* OrderSQL.selectOrderResult */ SELECT A.ORD_NO AS "ordNo", A.ORD_DT AS "ordDt", A.ORD_STAT_CD AS "ordStatCd", A.PAY_TP_CD AS "payTpCd", A.PAY_AMT AS "payAmt", A.DELV_AMT AS "delvAmt", A.DEPOSITOR_NM AS "depositorNm", A.PG_APRV_NO AS "pgAprvNo", DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(A.ORD_DT, INTERVAL 3 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS "payLimitDt", A.RECIVER_NM AS "reciverNm", A.DELV_HP_NO AS "delvHpNo", A.DELV_ZIPCODE AS "delvZipcode", A.DELV_BASE_ADDR AS "delvBaseAddr", A.DELV_DTL_ADDR AS "delvDtlAddr", A.DELV_MSG AS "delvMsg", CASE A.PAY_TP_CD WHEN '10' THEN '무통장입금' WHEN '20' THEN '카드결제' END AS "payTpNm", CASE A.ORD_STAT_CD WHEN '10' THEN '주문확인' WHEN '20' THEN '결제완료' WHEN '30' THEN '배송준비' WHEN '40' THEN '배송중' WHEN '50' THEN '배송완료' WHEN '90' THEN '주문취소' END AS "ordStatNm", D.INVOICE_NO AS "invoiceNo", CASE D.DELV_CO_CD WHEN 'CJ' THEN 'CJ대한통운' WHEN 'HANJIN' THEN '한진택배' WHEN 'LOTTE' THEN '롯데택배' WHEN 'POST' THEN '우체국택배' WHEN 'LOGEN' THEN '로젠택배' END AS "delvCoNm" FROM TB_ORD_MST A LEFT JOIN TB_ORD_DELV_INFO D ON A.ORD_NO = D.ORD_NO WHERE A.ORD_NO = #{ordNo} AND A.MBR_NO = #{mbrNo}

/* OrderSQL.selectOrderDtlList */ SELECT A.ORD_SEQ AS "ordSeq", A.PRD_CD AS "prdCd", A.ORD_QTY AS "ordQty", A.ORD_AMT AS "ordAmt", A.SALE_PRC AS "salePrc", B.PRD_NM AS "prdNm", B.SMPL_DESC AS "smplDesc", C.IMG_PATH AS "imgPath" FROM TB_ORD_DTL A INNER JOIN TB_PRD_MST B ON A.PRD_CD = B.PRD_CD LEFT JOIN TB_PRD_IMG C ON A.PRD_CD = C.PRD_CD AND C.IMG_TP_CD = '10' AND C.SORT_SEQ = 1 WHERE A.ORD_NO = #{ordNo} ORDER BY A.ORD_SEQ
